bull.point: Revenue compound annual growth rate reached 20.9% over 3 years with Mar 2026 revenue hitting ₹14,748 Cr.
bull.evidence: Revenue compounded 20.9% a year over 3 years

bull.point: Strong profitability profile supported by a ROCE of 34% and a debt-to-equity ratio of just 0.07.

bull.evidence: We get that [reach $5 billion aspiration] as well at a nice scale by FY31.
